verses.1: So, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. I am not willing to write those same things for you; it’s too dangerous for you.
verses.2: Look at those people, look at those evil workers, look at the chaos.
verses.3: For we are indeed those who are being circumcised; we are those who worship and glorify the Spirit of God in Christ Jesus. We do not believe in flesh and blood at all.
verses.4: And I believe in it, both in spirit and in flesh. If anyone else believes in it in terms of flesh, then I’ll go even further.
verses.5: He was eighteen years old, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew from among the Hebrews. He followed the laws of the Pharisees.
verses.6: In pursuit of his own interests, he persecuted the church; in accordance with justice, he treated those who were unjustly treated according to the law.
verses.7: But what truly brought me joy was what I did because of Christ.
verses.8: But I also believe that it is a sin to go beyond the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, through whom all things were condemned. I also believe that it is necessary to humble oneself in order to win Christ’s favor.
verses.9: And I found in him that he did not have the justice that comes from law, but rather the justice that comes from faith in Christ. It’s the justice that comes from God, based on faith.
verses.10: To know him, as well as the power of his transformation, and to understand the relationships between his various aspects. By conforming to his death.
verses.11: I hope to understand what it means to be resurrected from the dead.
verses.12: Not that I’ve already been captured or killed, but I will still pursue those who have been captured by Christ. I want to know who among them has been killed by Christ.
verses.13: Brothers, I do not consider myself to be trapped in this situation. I’m either trapped behind, or I’m trying to move forward.
verses.14: In order to seek the reward that comes from the above-mentioned call of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.15: So, those who are truly perfect, we will take care of that. And if you decide to do something else, then God will reveal it to you.
verses.16: In addition to what we’ve already achieved, that’s also part of the same “thing”.
verses.17: Be like me, brothers. And act in a manner that is consistent with our traditions.
verses.18: Many, indeed, are those who travel around; I have said this to you many times. Now, I also say that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ.
verses.19: What kind of loss is this? What has caused God’s glory and honor to be lost in shame? Those who are concerned only with their own interests.
verses.20: For our city exists in heaven. From there, we will receive salvation from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.21: He who will transform our humble bodies into ones that are in harmony with His glorious body, through the power of His strength and the ability to control everything.
